name: localsend
title: LocalSend
description: Send files or text to LocalSend devices on your network, and open what LocalSend received.
author: tapuuk

commands.name: search-localsend
commands.title: Search LocalSend
commands.description: Devices found on the LAN and files LocalSend received; Enter sends to a device or opens a received file.

preferences.name: alias
preferences.title: Device Name
preferences.description: Name other devices see when you send. Leave empty to use the name set in LocalSend, then the hostname.

preferences.name: scanInterfaces
preferences.title: Scan Interfaces
preferences.description: Comma-separated network interface names the device scan is limited to (for example eth0). Empty means every ordinary LAN interface is scanned automatically, never a tunnel or a VPN.
